plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: Clouds of delicate, blush-white blossoms cover bare branches before the leaves appear. Whole streets and riverbanks turn pale pink, and petals drift down like snow in the spring breeze.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late March to early April, with peak bloom timing varying by city and year
plants.location: Japan (Honshu), including Tokyo and Kyoto, and Washington, D.C., USA
plants.funFact: Japan's peak cherry blossom date is tracked so closely that the 'cherry blossom front' is forecast each year as it moves north across the country. Flowers usually last only about a week.

plants.name: Narcissus pseudonarcissus
plants.description: Nodding golden trumpets framed by paler yellow petals brighten woodland edges and meadows. Wild populations form drifts of yellow across the spring landscape.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late February to April, with peak bloom often in March and early April
plants.location: Woodlands and meadows of western Europe, including England, Wales and France
plants.funFact: Wild daffodils are smaller and more delicate than the garden varieties bred from them. They contain alkaloids such as galantamine, which has been developed into a medicine.

plants.name: Colchicum autumnale
plants.description: This species is not a good fit for April, so it is not featured.
